Name: Revival Blessing
Effect: The User must spend all of their remaining Will Points, if the User has no remaining Will Points, this Move fails. Restore consciousness and 2 HP to a fainted Target. If no Target is fainted this Move fails. The Target does not need to be an Active Combatant.
Description: The Pokémon prays to the skies with such selfless fervor and devotion that a miracle is granted.
